info.title: Patreon API v1
info.description:
OpenAPI 3.1 specification for the Patreon API v1, split into subfiles using JSON `$ref` references.

## Key concepts

- **JSON:API**: All responses follow the [JSON:API](https://jsonapi.org/) specification. Primary data is in `data`, related resources in `included`.
- **Pledges**: The v1 core patronage object. A `pledge` represents a patron's subscription to a campaign. Replaced by `Member` in API v2.
- **Rewards**: v1 equivalent of Tiers in v2. Define pledge levels and benefits.
- **Default fields**: Unlike v2, v1 returns a sensible set of fields by default. Use the `includes` parameter to include related resources.

## Authentication

All requests require an OAuth 2.0 Bearer access token. Obtain one via the OAuth flow (`GET /oauth2/authorize` → `POST /api/oauth2/token`) or use your Creator's Access Token from the developer portal.

## API v1 Scopes

| Scope | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `users` | Read user profile data |
| `my-campaign` | Read the creator's own campaign |
| `pledges-to-me` | Read pledges made to the creator |
| `campaigns` | Read campaign data |

## Rate Limits

Requests are rate-limited at both the client and token level. HTTP 429 responses include a `retry_after_seconds` field. An edge-level block (30 minutes) is triggered after 2,000+ bad requests in a 10-minute window.

## Directory structure

```
openapi.json                          ← root entry point
components/
  schemas/          (14 files)         ← Error, User, Campaign, Pledge, Reward, Goal, Webhook, etc.
  parameters/       (1 file)           ← includes
  responses/        (6 files)          ← shared HTTP error responses
  securitySchemes/  (2 files)          ← OAuth2, BearerToken
paths/
  oauth/            (2 files)          ← token exchange + refresh
  identity/         (1 file)           ← /current_user
  campaigns/        (2 files)          ← /current_user/campaigns + /campaigns/{id}
  pledges/          (1 file)           ← /campaigns/{id}/pledges
  webhooks/         (2 files)          ← webhook CRUD
```

tags.name: OAuth
tags.description: OAuth 2.0 token exchange and refresh endpoints. No authentication required.

tags.name: Identity
tags.description: Fetch the current authenticated user's profile.

tags.name: Campaigns
tags.description: Access campaign data — the creator's page including rewards and goals.

tags.name: Pledges
tags.description: Access pledge data — patron subscriptions to a campaign. v1 equivalent of Members in v2.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Manage webhooks for real-time pledge event notifications (`pledges:create`, `pledges:update`, `pledges:delete`).
